import zipfile, re
with zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx') as z:
    xml = z.open('word/document.xml').read().decode('utf-8')
# Pretty print paragraphs
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>|<w:delText[^>]*>(.*?)</w:delText>', p, re.S)
    content = ''.join(a or b or '' for a, b in texts)
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val=\"([^\"]+)\"', p)
    print(f'[{i}] style={style.group(1) if style else None} :: {content!r}')
"
